tui.notification_kinds.word_closed.role: Kind word in a `/notifications` listing row: `✓ <session> — <word> · 2h`
tui.notification_kinds.word_closed.tone: lowercase single word/short phrase, past participle
tui.notification_kinds.word_closed.note: EN-only context sidecar. Sits after an em dash and before a middle dot and an age. The store token is `closed` (a journal word, not English), so this is its human reading. Lowercase; no punctuation. No ICU arguments.

tui.notification_kinds.word_retired.role: Kind phrase in a `/notifications` listing row: `⊘ <session> — <phrase> · 2h`
tui.notification_kinds.word_retired.tone: lowercase short phrase naming the cause
tui.notification_kinds.word_retired.note: EN-only context sidecar. The session's turn was cut because Local Operator was updating itself; the phrase must say WHY, not blame the user. Lowercase; no punctuation. No ICU arguments.
